Release_Year blank: repository start date not confirmed. Meta_Data blank: README only. Recipients anonymised.
Unlabelled; used as the legitimate class. Single class, so Balanced = FALSE.

One row for three releases (2005, 2006, 2007): split them if you score each. Split blank: delivered as an ordered stream, not train/test. Licence agreement needed. Availability 'On request' = licence, account, agreement or embargo.
Advance-fee fraud only. Year = ACL repository release (ADCR2008T001).

Year = paper (Zenodo record may be 2023). Spam rows from spam corpora carry the positive label. Balance varies per set.

Origin not documented; same size as Email4S. 39% phishing, so Balanced = FALSE. HF mirror (zefang-liu) is the same data.
Fraud and Spam blank: unclear whether fraud and spam sources were kept and how they are labelled. Split and balance not checked.
Sampled from Nazario, Nigerian Fraud and SpamAssassin; fraud emails carry the phishing label. Human-written. Meant as a test set.

Format and split not checked. Three languages.

146 emails in matched pairs; cue labels and human judgements included. Human-in-the-loop generation.
Leave-one-generator-out and grouped splits provided. Public on release (Zenodo, Kaggle, Hugging Face).
